# serde: Serialization and Deserialization
Serde is the framework for serializing and deserializing Rust data structures efficiently and generically.

```rust
// serde derives Serialize and Deserialize for zero-allocation JSON parsing
// #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
// struct User { id: u64, username: String }
```
